description: `plain()?` applies `?` to a callee with no `!` in its signature. Per §19.5.4 the operator requires a failable callee, so E-ERROR-004 fires (§34: Error).
rationale: §19.5.4 — `?` is the propagate operator for a FAILABLE call. Applied to a callee that cannot fail it propagates nothing, so it is dead syntax that reads as error handling — the most misleading shape available, because it tells a reader the call has a failure mode when its type says it does not.
